items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: there was, uh, Alton Purnell and, and Don Ewell

ctx.x: Uh. Uh. Yeah, so they, the only changes in personnel were, as far as I can recall, uh, uh, there were three drummers and two piano players. There was Baby, Kaiser Marshall, and, and, uh, Al Steele. This is, uh, the two engagements. Oh. And, uh, there was, uh, Alton Purnell and, and Don Ewell. Uh, there might have been maybe a third piano player sometime that I didn't know about, but as, as I recall, those, those are the ones.
Yeah. And who is Don Ewell?
